strict_rules: NEVER draw procedural stick-figures or polygon-from-scratch character bodies in Python.

ALWAYS generate the 16-bit HD-2D base character sprite (<hero>_v2_base.jpg, 1024x1024, facing +X right on pure #FFFFFF white background, empty hands at sides, no cape/weapon) and matching bust portrait using generate_image FIRST.

NEVER pass another champion's base sprite in ImagePaths when generating a new champion's full-body sprite (to avoid copying their armor/silhouette); pass the new champion's own base sprite in ImagePaths when generating their matching portrait.

ALWAYS pre-flatten continuous AI gradients via MedianFilter (3x3 head / 5x5 body), segment into anatomical parts with 0 unassigned foreground pixels, quantize every 104x104 frame to a curated 20-color MASTER_PALETTE, run 2-pass cardinal orphan despeckling + interior pinhole fill, and apply a crisp 1px directional Selout outline.
ALWAYS plant grounded boots at y_104 = 99 (y_208 = 198..199) paired with groundPlantOffset = 4 in draw() so all 10 champions stand uniformly on their ground shadows.
ALWAYS enforce a 2px transparent safety margin in 104x104 (4px in 208x208) across all 270 frames (0/270 boundary clips) and 29/29 distinct frame transitions per row.
ALWAYS use multi-stage grounded death animations (F00..F06 impact stagger -> F07..F14 knee buckle -> F15..F22 progressive prone/supine laydown -> F23..F29 grounded rest).
ALWAYS generate and visually inspect debug_<hero>_30fps_left_F00_F14.png, debug_<hero>_30fps_right_F15_F29.png, and debug_<hero>_30fps_vfx.png using view_file.
